headline: UK Cancels East Midlands Road Projects to Divert Funding to Defence
summary: The UK government confirmed that upgrades to the A38 around Derby and the Newark bypass on the A46 have been shelved to divert more than £400 million into defence spending.
why: Government infrastructure spending reallocations directly impact regional development and civil engineering contractors.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: The decision alters national public expenditure priorities between infrastructure and defense.
